scope.form: 2009 multisolvent seed extract; separate 2021 methanolic seed extract
scope.cancer_model: Breast, pancreas and prostate cell lines
scope.comparison: Medium with DMSO without extract in 2009

proof.read_level: Full primary main paper methods, results, figure captions and discussion read; supplementary files not independently audited
proof.exact_result: S-013 full PMC3095649: triplicate wells per concentration, 72-hour MTT versus medium+DMSO. Figure 1 reports dose-dependent signal loss; Figure 3 live/dead staining at 96 hours. Not direct cell-number endpoint. Normal prostate cultures do not establish systemic safety. TGF-beta methods 1 ng/ml versus results 5 ng/ml; diosgenin methods 15 mM versus micromolar elsewhere. S-014 PMC8057839 full main paper: Figure 3, three independent experiments, 48-hour MCF-7/SK-BR3 viability, low-level stimulation and higher-level inhibition; IC50 150 and 40 micrograms/ml. Later SK-BR3 dose labels conflict with the selected doses; mouse methods six/group versus Table 2 mortality denominator ten. No genetic perturbation establishes p53 necessity. No clinical efficacy.

records.findings: The seed extract lowered the cancer cell activity signal in the 2009 lab test. Cell death was seen with separate stains. Proof is in Figures 1 and 3. The test did not measure tumors or survival in people.

scope.form: Ricinus communis hydroethanolic fruit extract injected intraperitoneally

proof.read_level: Full primary main paper methods, results, figure captions and discussion read; supplementary files not independently audited
proof.exact_result: Full PMC6787038 main paper. Female BALB/c 4T1 mammary-fat-pad tumors, randomized ten/group; saline vehicle versus intraperitoneal RCFE 0.5 mg/kg four doses 72 h apart from day 10 to day 22. Figure 5C reports >88% lower tumor volume than control at final check, not 88% regression of individual tumors. Cell MTT is activity, not direct death counts; Annexin V/PI and PARP cleavage separate. STAT3 phosphorylation, Bax/Bcl-2 and caspase-7 associations do not prove necessity; no rescue/knockdown isolation. No survival endpoint or comprehensive toxicology. Figure captions mean±SEM versus methods mean±SD inconsistency. Not castor oil, skin packs or established human treatment.

records.findings: The fruit extract group had lower tumor volume than the salt water group in this mouse test. Each group had ten mice. Proof is in Figure 5. The test used belly shots, not oil on skin.

scope.cancer_model: Subcutaneous Colon-26, BALB/c mice, five/group in Figure 3
scope.comparison: PBS; liposomal doxorubicin; anti-PD-L1; broth unmatched
scope.endpoint: Day30 complete response; mouse survival through day60

proof.read_level: Full primary main paper methods, results, figure captions and discussion read; supplementary files not independently audited
proof.exact_result: Full PMC12710904 main paper. Figure 2 screening n=3/group; Figure 3 efficacy n=5/group, subcutaneous Colon-26 in immunocompetent BALB/c. Single IV E. americana in Pearl Core E-MC64 broth; shared PBS control is not matched culture medium. Figure 3D CR 5/5 versus anti-PD-L1 1/5 at day 30; CR defined no palpable mass for >=30 days, not histological eradication. Figure 3E follow-up to day 60. Rechallenge claimed 0/10 versus 10/10; supplementary raw data not re-audited. Higher than 1e9 CFU caused acute mortality; tested optimum equals maximum tolerated dose. Figure 6 blood time day30 versus results day7; methods multiple times. Virulence analysis uses public ATCC33852 genome, not isolate whole-genome sequencing. Descriptive immune markers not causal depletion experiments. Not human benefit/safety or superiority to standard human colorectal regimens.

records.findings: All five mice in the tested germ group had no felt tumor for at least 30 days. Proof is in Figure 3. The result was from one small mouse test. The germ was a named isolate, not raw frog gut.

records.question: Did radiation lower return of cancer in the older trials after mastectomy with one to three positive nodes?

scope.form: Chest wall and regional node radiation after mastectomy
scope.cancer_model: Older invasive breast cancer trials, one to three positive nodes after axillary dissection

records.findings: Yes. In older trials, fewer women had cancer come back with rays after breast removal. Fewer were dead from breast cancer. The gain for a person today can differ. A node sample alone is not a full stage or plan.
